ar_task.model_scope: assumed port power, ideal capacitor, ideal atomic NVM, assumed regulator/load, deterministic digital receiver; no calibrated IV or hardware
ar_task.iv_model: Explicit assumed power at an assumed 0.75 Voc operating point. Lux is metadata, never an input to a watts conversion. No source response outside these points.

service_semantics.history: Every durable record must survive a reset; sample retention and continuous new sampling have separate gates.
service_semantics.upload: Oldest unacknowledged first, remove from pending only after ACK; receiver key=(device,sequence).
service_semantics.gap: After reset report an unobserved interval bracketed by last durable observation and fresh synchronization, without claiming exact outage times.
service_semantics.time: No powered RTC after brownout; records without synchronization have an interval and UNKNOWN absolute time.
service_semantics.priority: Abnormal event records have priority over routine samples on capacity exhaustion; every eviction is counted and declared.

light_metadata.spectrum: Same A0 LED contract; calibrated spectral irradiance/IV unavailable

source_notes.sense_storage_j: Reuses the registered A/R 20 uJ storage-side sample impulse as a proposed RMS sampler cost; temperature-load precedent is not qualification of vibration hardware.
source_notes.wake_storage_j: Proposed ideal 1 uJ wake impulse; no independent device power measurement.
source_notes.standby_power_w: Proposed ideal 0.5 uW powered RMS front-end standby; off when the managed rail is off.
source_notes.write_storage_j: Unchanged A/R ideal atomic 5 uJ store impulse; persistence does not supply detection power.
source_notes.ar_chain: Unchanged source port/cold-start/PMIC/boot/ESR/TX parameters and digital AR wire/CRC envelope; no calibrated PV or RF model.

service.scope: Every individual start/stop plus continuous keepalive; darkness is applicable; no occupancy inference or final-state substitution.
service.threshold_comparison: Strict > for start and < for stop; equality resets the corresponding confirmation timer.
service.event_time_basis: Confirmation time, not raw rising/falling edge.
service.keepalive_basis: Accepted active-state messages must cover each confirmed active interval with gaps <=120 s; keepalive outside confirmed active state fails.
service.waveform_abi: Ordered contiguous [start_s,end_s) piecewise constant external RMS g segments; amplitude is an externally supplied RMS observation, not harvested mechanical energy.
service.sampling_semantics: Powered periodic RMS observations with declared zero-order hold between consecutive successful samples. Confirmation runs only on successful powered wake/sample; unobserved gaps reset timers.
service.radio_scope: Ideal atomic A/R storage-side TX impulse and AR digital wire/CRC with O message kinds; not a BLE air link.

provenance.qualification: Previously independently checked digital A/R apparatus only; PV/PMIC dynamics, vibration costs and physical receiver remain UNKNOWN.
provenance.hardware_match: O0 C fixed at the original 15 mF and PV area at 15 cm2 across the first three episodes; other AR hardware fixed. General ABI supports a separately frozen legal C range, never participant changes to case limits.
